intent_snapshot.goal: Implement S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md: the Claude Host Review dispatch envelope carries only the fields the Claude Agent tool accepts, and the packaged reviewer definition's native tool boundary is pinned by a test.

acceptance.assertion: Per S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md (AN-2): the dispatch envelope returned by the Claude Host prepareReview has exactly the keys name and prompt; name is the packaged reviewer agent and prompt is the reservation marker line followed by the reserved prompt unchanged. It carries no max_turns and no run_in_background. ReviewRequest.maxTurns remains on the shared type and the Pi dispatch parameters are unchanged. Reservation binding, hook observation, settlement of a valid reviewer receipt, and every blocked result with its reason, release decision and recovery_action are unchanged. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.

Per S1 of docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md (AN-3): the packaged reviewer agent definition declares a tool allowlist that is exactly Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, so Agent, Edit, Write and NotebookEdit are natively denied; its frontmatter declares none of hooks, mcpServers or permissionMode, which the Host ignores for plugin agents; and it still states that a dispatched reviewer is never continued or re-prompted, that the reserved prompt is dispatched verbatim, and that a blocked submit_review is recovered only through its returned recovery_action. The test fails when a tool is added to or removed from the allowlist.

advisory_findings.summary: docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md:30 still states review_host.ts documents that `run_in_background: false` is not honoured, but the reworded comment at review_host.ts:149-155 no longer says it, leaving a live spec sentence factually stale against this revision

evidence.trigger: Read the live (non-archive) spec's 'Current behavior' bullet after the review_commit: the bullet asserts review_host.ts documents `run_in_background: false` is not honoured, while git show b486803:plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts now reads 'this Host has no synchronous mode and no background switch, so the dispatch envelope carries nothing that would ask for one'; the only surviving pins of the old wording are the unchanged test header comment tests/claude-review-host-async-agent.test.ts:25-26 and historical CHANGELOG.md:466-467, and no test asserts the spec sentence, so the drift is silent

advisory_findings.summary: Dropping max_turns removes the only turn budget the Claude reviewer could have had, and the 'no receiver' claim rests on a code comment rather than recorded host evidence, so a future Claude build that does accept it yields a silently unbounded reviewer

evidence.trigger: A Claude Code build whose `Agent` tool accepts max_turns: prepareReview at review_host.ts:330-336 now emits only {name,prompt}, so reviewTurnBudget(workload) from runtime/assurance/coordinator.ts:1120 reaches ReviewRequest.maxTurns (host_port.ts:6) but is never projected; the recorded-conformance note at tests/claude-review-host-async-agent.test.ts:25-26 evidences only that run_in_background is not honoured, not that max_turns is rejected, and the Pi projection at .pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts:64 remains intact so this is Claude-only

advisory_findings.summary: The cited authority docs/specs/host-native-subagent-definitions.spec.md is absent from both base_head and review_commit (worktree-only, untracked), so AN-2/AN-3 could not be checked against spec text inside the immutable revision; the review was performed against the assertion text embedded in the bundle instead
